group: 2.A6=SL(2,9) generated by four lifted (0,1,j) three-cycles, j=2,3,4,5
exact_clifford_basis: Cl6 over Q with e_i²=+1, basis masks0..63; root normalized (e_i-e_j)/sqrt2; products of two roots rational
spinorial_4D_construction: Via Spin(6)≅SU(4), each even Clifford lift acts on complex chiral half-spin module C^4. Central -1 acts as -I4, so the 4D representation does not factor through A6. The explicit exact Clifford group words specify generators without requiring floating-point matrices.
SU5_embedding: diag(4D spinorial SU4 action,1) lies inside SU5 (det=1) and is faithful SL2(9). The central element acts as diag(-I4,+1), not a scalar, and has determinant1.
E8_candidate: A maximal-rank (SU5_L×SU5_G)/Z5 subgroup of compact E8 admits this SL2(9) subgroup in SU5_L. SU5_G commutes with it, but the actual E8 centralizer, translation compatibility, Lorentz chiral physical matter and dynamical gauge symmetry require separate calculations.
not_done: No faithful 4D Hilbert spinor wavefunction as observed fermion; no E8 root matrices or full commutant restriction are computed; no Z3.M translations or physical vacuum, no SM generations. This route is distinct from the parallel Weyl-Tits A6 bosonic subgroup.
